scope: drafts of runs whose case accepts a draft and whose outcome was a draft

apollo.1.note: Opens by restating the 500,000-users fact verbatim; scale is a generic hook; 'assess that quality' twice.

apollo.2.note: Logical record-quality link; one dense paragraph that repeats itself.

buttondown.1.note: Warm and natural; the no-fee angle is good but the offer competes with Buttondown's own concierge migration.

buttondown.2.note: Admits its own irrelevance ('would only seem relevant if...'), which undercuts the pitch.

duolingo.1.note: B2 expansion to recorded dialogues; specific closing question.

duolingo.2.note: Same angle, concise; asks which course is the priority.

gitlab.1.note: Stated product priorities to migration guides is logical; the opening recites the priorities at length.

gitlab.2.note: Capgemini alliance to migration guides is a stretch; reads naturally.

linear.1.note: Agent-workflow interviews are relevant; long and stiff ('I wondered how you're gathering...').

linear.2.note: Relevant; 'interviews could help your team understand how those workflows are working' is stiff.

mercury.1.note: Mercury Books onboarding is a specific, sensible sequence to offer.

mercury.2.note: 2.4x more AI companies to a tailored founder path; good question.

plausible.1.note: No-cookie, EU-only processing as search differentiators; clean.

plausible.2.note: Acknowledges they never paid for ads and proposes a small test alongside; honest and well judged.

ramp.1.note: 'expanding expense tools' is unsupported (review flagged it three times); opens with the sender.

ramp.2.note: 70+ launches to a policy template is a stretch; 'expense-management coverage' is vague.

ru-kontur.1.note: The Russia-Uzbekistan e-document launch as a source of new support questions is sharp; natural Russian.

ru-kontur.2.note: Correct, natural Russian; a concrete pilot on one category.

ru-skyeng.1.note: Relevant self-study angle; 'на слух' repeated in consecutive sentences.

ru-skyeng.2.note: Conversation clubs and chatbot to voice-over is a loose link.

ru-vkusvill.1.note: 4,200 own-brand products to a sample audit; natural.

ru-vkusvill.2.note: Same angle; offers audit criteria, a low-commitment ask.

stripe.1.note: Tells the Head of Documentation what their docs explain; generic link.

stripe.2.note: Same 'I noticed Stripe's docs explain...' opening; concrete starting point helps.

transistor.1.note: 24% growth to B2B brands needing editing is a guess presented as momentum.

transistor.2.note: Ghost integration and shared publishers is a specific partner angle.

tuple.1.note: Relevant; the first sentence is clunky.

tuple.2.note: Concise and concrete; good closing question.
